title: Lower Deficits Are Key to Affordability: MacGuineas
title_cn: 降低赤字是负担能力的关键：MacGuineas
summary: Maya MacGuineas, president of the Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget, says bringing down deficits is the "single most important thing" policymakers can do to improve affordability in a lasting way, arguing that heavy federal borrowing is putting upward pressure on inflation and interest rates. She also says there is a "huge mismatch" between politicians' warnings about the fiscal outlook and their willingness to embrace the higher taxes and spending cuts she says are needed to address it. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Crayton Questions DOJ Election Monitor Push
title_cn: 克雷顿质疑司法部选举监视器的推动

He also weighs in on the Trump administration's push to obtain state voter-roll data and says there is little evidence of noncitizens voting in US elections, arguing such cases are "minuscule" when they occur. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. Malliotakis Pushes Capital Gains Relief for Seniors
title_cn: 众议员马利奥塔基斯推动老年人资本收益减免
summary: Republican Rep. Nicole Malliotakis of New York discusses her legislation aimed at raising the capital gains tax exclusion for seniors selling longtime homes, arguing it could make it easier for them to downsize and free up housing inventory. Rep. Malliotakis, who serves on the House Ways and Means Committee, also weighs in on the federal debt nearing $40 trillion and pushes back on concerns about the deficit impact of the Republican reconciliation package, arguing economic growth can help generate additional revenue. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Global Bond Slump Raises Fed Questions | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/18/2026
title_cn: 全球债券暴跌引发美联储疑问彭博商业周刊日报 8/18/2026
summary: Long-term debt costs are soaring as the bond market slumps. Bloomberg's Chief US Interest Rate Strategist Ira Jersey and Corporate Finance Reporter Davide Barbuscia explain why this jump is happening and what it signals to the Fed. Then, Empower Chief Investment Strategist Marta Norton on this week's global bond slump and how it's changing investor positioning. Plus, China Beige Book COO Shehzad Qazi previews next month's meeting between China's Xi Jinping and President Trump, and the future of trade between the two countries. Finally, Root CEO Alex Timm discusses how his company uses AI to help determine behavior-based car insurance. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zelenskyy’s Popular Ex-Minister Calls for Ukrainian Election
title_cn: 泽伦斯基受欢迎的前部长呼吁乌克兰大选
summary: The popular former Ukrainian defense minister, whose firing by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy triggered nationwide protests, strongly hinted at his political ambitions with a late-night video calling for wartime elections.

title: UAE Says Iran Fired Two Missiles at Country as War Drags On
title_cn: 阿联酋表示，随着战争的持续，伊朗向该国发射了两枚导弹
summary: The United Arab Emirates said that two ballistic missiles were fired toward the country from Iran, the Islamic Republic’s first known attack on the Gulf nation since May as the wider Middle East war continues unabated.

title: Big Take Asia: North Korea’s New Economic Windfall
title_cn: 亚洲大事：朝鲜新的经济意外之财
summary: On the Big Take Asia podcast, K. Oanh Ha and Bloomberg’s Cat Barton unpack North Korea’s surprising rise from pandemic-era hardship to a multibillion-dollar windfall, and discuss how the country’s newfound wealth is reshaping geopolitical alliances in Asia.  (Source: Bloomberg)
